migrations.name: Initial Schema
migrations.description: Create initial database schema with users, roles, time slots, classes, and selections

migrations.name: RLS Policies
migrations.description: Enable Row Level Security and create security policies

migrations.name: Triggers and Functions
migrations.description: Create database functions and triggers

migrations.name: Sample Data
migrations.description: Insert sample time slots and demo data

migrations.name: Fix Classes RLS Policy
migrations.description: Update RLS policy for classes table to allow proper access

migrations.name: Support Multiple Grades
migrations.description: Change classes.grade from single integer to array of integers

migrations.name: Add Scope to Classes
migrations.description: Add scope column to classes table for test/prod separation

migrations.name: Add Double Lesson and Room
migrations.description: Add is_double and room columns to classes table for double lesson support and room assignment

migrations.name: Remodel Day Structure
migrations.description: Safely remodel structure to move day information from time_slots to classes

migrations.name: Setup Approval System
migrations.description: Setup approval system - ensure proper user_roles structure has approval functionality

migrations.name: Fix Admin RLS Policies
migrations.description: Add RLS policies to allow admins to view and manage all user approvals

migrations.name: Add User Profile Fields
migrations.description: Add first_name and last_name fields to users table for profile management

migrations.name: Add Children Management
migrations.description: Create tables for children, parent-child relationships, and sharing functionality

migrations.name: Migrate Existing Schedules to Children
migrations.description: Create dummy children for existing users and migrate their schedule selections

migrations.name: Add Scope to Children
migrations.description: Add scope field to children table with "prod" as default, similar to classes

migrations.name: Add Enrollment Functions
migrations.description: Add database functions to get class enrollment counts

migrations.name: Add Class Slots
migrations.description: Add slots JSONB column to classes for multiple day/time-slot pairs per class; backfill from existing day_of_week/time_slot_id (including double-lesson second slot); drop superseded columns

migrations.name: Add Group and Track Fields
migrations.description: Add nullable group_number (קבוצה) and track_number (מסלול) columns to classes, add track_number to children, relax children.group_number to allow NULL, update create_child_with_relationship/children_with_parents accordingly, and bring get_children_with_parent_status under tracking with track_number added

migrations.name: Drop Child Sharing
migrations.description: Remove the child-sharing feature: drop child_share_tokens table (and its indexes/RLS policies) and the generate_child_share_token/accept_shared_child functions

migrations.name: Fix Children Roster Permissions
migrations.description: Close a public data leak: switch children_with_parents to security_invoker and add an admin-or-staff check inside get_children_with_parent_status, revoking public/anon access to both

migrations.name: Allow Staff Update Children
migrations.description: Add an admin-or-staff UPDATE policy on public.children so staff can update children they don't have a parent relationship to (e.g. clearing a track), which previously failed with PGRST116 because RLS filtered the update to 0 rows

migrations.name: Add Selection Status
migrations.description: Add draft/committed status to schedule_selections, replace RLS policies with status-aware ones (also fixing two pre-existing bugs: staff unable to edit each other's committed picks, and staff unable to commit one class for multiple students), and update enrollment functions/view to count committed selections only

migrations.name: Split Track Draft Committed
migrations.description: Split children.track_number into track_number_draft (parent-owned) and track_number_committed (staff/admin-owned), mirroring the schedule_selections draft/committed split. No new RLS policy -- enforced at the API layer. Updates create_child_with_relationship (gains p_status), get_children_with_parent_status (always resolves committed), and children_with_parents (new column shape) accordingly.

migrations.name: Add Get Class Enrolled Children
migrations.description: Introduce committed_enrollments as the single source of truth for "what counts as enrolled" (child_id IS NOT NULL AND status = 'committed'), used by get_class_enrollment_counts/get_class_enrollment_count/classes_with_enrollment (rewritten to read from it instead of duplicating the predicate) and by a new get_class_enrolled_children(p_class_id) SECURITY DEFINER function returning the roster of children committed-enrolled in a class, bypassing the children table's parent-scoped RLS SELECT policy for staff/admin (same problem get_children_with_parent_status solves for the Students page), with its own internal admin/staff+approved check so the roster can't be enumerated by arbitrary authenticated users

migrations.name: Allow Staff Delete Children
migrations.description: Add an admin-or-staff DELETE policy on public.children so staff can delete children they don't have a parent relationship to, which previously silently no-op'd (0 rows deleted, no error) because RLS filtered the delete out

migrations.name: Harden Visibility And Search Path
migrations.description: Close out remaining Security Advisor findings: revoke anon SELECT on tables where RLS already returns zero rows to anonymous callers (children, parent_child_relationships, schedule_selections, user_roles, users), restrict classes/time_slots to authenticated only (no pre-login schedule view exists or is planned), pin search_path on is_admin/get_class_enrollment_count/get_class_enrollment_counts, and drop the orphaned, unreferenced is_admin_user()

migrations.name: Lock Down Enrollment Views And Child Creation
migrations.description: Revoke anon/authenticated access to committed_enrollments (an RLS-bypassing internal view that was never locked down, exposing every class's child_id/class_id enrollment pairs to anon), revoke anon SELECT on classes_with_enrollment (anon-exposed since it was created, missed in 026), and harden create_child_with_relationship: pin search_path (missed in 026) and add an approved parent/staff/admin role check (the original share-token fix in 019 deliberately left this function's authorization unchanged)

migrations.name: Admin Only Class Create Delete
migrations.description: Restrict classes INSERT/DELETE RLS policies to admins only (dropping the staff-inclusive policies from 005); staff retains UPDATE (edit) access, which is unchanged

migrations.name: Add Last Sign In At
migrations.description: Add last_sign_in_at column to public.users, synced from auth.users via a sign-in trigger (sync_last_sign_in_at/on_auth_user_sign_in), plus a one-time backfill, so the admin User Management page can display last sign-in time

migrations.name: Add Added By To Enrolled Children
migrations.description: Issue #110: extend get_class_enrolled_children (DROP+CREATE, since its RETURNS TABLE shape changes) to also return the committing user's id, first/last name, and commit timestamp, by widening committed_enrollments to carry schedule_selections.user_id/created_at and joining public.users; reissues the REVOKE/GRANT pair after CREATE to avoid the anon-EXECUTE grant regression DROP FUNCTION would otherwise reintroduce

migrations.name: Child Ownership And Duplicates
migrations.description: Add children.created_by provenance column (backfilled from each child's current primary parent_child_relationships row), delete parent_child_relationships rows that wrongly link a staff/admin (not also an approved parent) as a child's parent, update create_child_with_relationship to only link the caller as parent when they are an approved parent (staff/admin creations are recorded via created_by instead), add a staff/admin SELECT policy on children, and add a claim_child RPC letting an approved parent attach themselves to a parentless child

migrations.name: Expose Creator In Roster RPC
migrations.description: Extend get_children_with_parent_status to also return created_by plus the creator's first/last name and email (left-joined from users), so the admin/staff Students page roster can show a 'created by' column

migrations.name: Allow Parent View Unclaimed Children
migrations.description: Add a SELECT policy letting any approved parent see children with no parent_child_relationships row yet (unclaimed only, never another family's claimed child), so the client-side duplicate-name+grade check and claim_child RPC can actually see staff-created unclaimed children instead of RLS hiding them entirely

migrations.name: Expose Creator Name For Visible Children
migrations.description: Add a SELECT policy on public.users letting any authenticated user see the row of whoever created a children row they can already see (composes on children's own RLS), so the duplicate-warning dialog can show the real creator name instead of falling back to a generic placeholder

migrations.name: Allow Parents View Committed Selections
migrations.description: Issue #49: add a read-only SELECT policy so a parent can view (never write) their own children's committed schedule_selections rows -- 022_add_selection_status.sql scoped parents' policy to status = 'draft' only, so the new committed-view toggle silently returned zero rows without this

migrations.name: Update Time Slots Schedule
migrations.description: Update the school's daily time slots to match the new published schedule: rename הפסקת אוכל -> ארוחת בוקר (09:00-09:10, was 09:00-09:15) and הפסקה -> הפסקה גדולה (unchanged 10:30-11:00), and retime שיעור ראשון/שני/שלישי/רביעי; all rows updated in place by name (no deletes/inserts, so classes.time_slot_id and its ON DELETE CASCADE are untouched). Also fixes validate_time_slot(), which still referenced time_slots.day_of_week, a column dropped in 009_remodel_day_structure.sql -- every INSERT/UPDATE on time_slots (including admin UI edits) has been erroring since migration 009

migrations.name: Add Schedule Overrides
migrations.description: Issue #106: fully isolated schedule_overrides table so staff can drop a one-off lesson into a specific child's schedule without it becoming a classes catalog row or a schedule_selections row. No FK to classes, no coupling to schedule_selections' draft/committed split or RLS.

migrations.name: Add Scope To Get Class Enrolled Children
migrations.description: Issue #134: add a target_scope text[] parameter to get_class_enrolled_children, filtering the joined children rows by scope so a test-scope child enrolled in a prod class no longer leaks into that class's production roster

migrations.name: Restore Added By With Scope
migrations.description: Issue #147: restore get_class_enrolled_children's added_by_user_id/added_by_first_name/added_by_last_name/added_by_at columns and the public.users join (dropped as an unintended side effect of 038's target_scope change, which re-declared the function from 024's shape instead of 030's) on top of 038's target_scope parameter/filter

migrations.name: Add Moderator Role
migrations.description: Issue #144: add 'moderator' to the user_role enum. Must be applied and committed on its own before migration 041, since Postgres forbids using a newly added enum value in the same transaction that adds it.

migrations.name: Moderator Can Manage Classes
migrations.description: Issue #144: grant moderator the same class create/delete rights as admin (canCreateClasses/canDeleteClasses, via a new is_admin_or_moderator() helper, staff still excluded) and the same class update rights as staff/admin (canManageClasses).

migrations.name: Harden Advisor Findings
migrations.description: Security Advisor cleanup: revoke anon/PUBLIC EXECUTE on seven SECURITY DEFINER functions (re-granting authenticated where the app needs it; sync_last_sign_in_at trigger function revoked from authenticated too), pin search_path on validate_time_slot() and is_admin_or_moderator(), and revoke anon SELECT on schedule_overrides. Permission tightening only, no logic change.

migrations.name: Link Users To Teachers
migrations.description: Issue #163 (Staff View part 2): users.display_name (unique, staff/admin only) plus optional user_id on classes and schedule_overrides; teacher becomes a cached label synced from display_name by triggers; get_staff_directory() RPC for staff and admin_set_display_name() RPC for admins. Structure only -- all links start empty.

migrations.name: Display Name In Creator RPCs
migrations.description: Issue #163 (Staff View part 2): get_children_with_parent_status gains creator_display_name and get_class_enrolled_children gains added_by_display_name (appended last; bodies otherwise unchanged from 032 / 039), so "created by" / "added by" show the Display Name, falling back to first + last name.
